function.name: code_find_symbol
function.description: Find symbols (functions, classes, interfaces, types, methods) in the semantic code index by name. Prefer this over search_start when looking for symbol definitions.

name.description: Symbol name or substring to search for.

kind.description: Optional symbol kind filter (e.g. function, class, interface, method, type).

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to return (capped at 50).

function.name: code_search
function.description: Perform semantic or hybrid vector/keyword search across the codebase index. Best for finding code matching a concept or natural language description.

query.description: Natural language or technical query describing desired functionality.

function.name: code_file_summary
function.description: Get architectural summary of a file from the semantic index: role, imports, exports, and symbol count.

function.name: code_dependencies
function.description: Query the file and symbol dependency graph. Returns incoming, outgoing, or bidirectional edges.

function.name: code_impact
function.description: Analyze the impact radius of modifying a symbol or file. Traces callers and dependents in the graph.

max_depth.description: Maximum traversal depth in the graph. Defaults to 3.

function.name: code_find_tests
function.description: Find tests that cover or relate to a given source file or symbol.

function.name: code_config_usage
function.description: Find configuration keys and environment variables used across the codebase.

key.description: Config key or env var name (e.g. DATABASE_URL, PORT).

function.name: code_context
function.description: Assemble a token-budgeted, relevance-ranked context bundle for a task or seed files.

task.description: Description of the task to gather context for.

files.description: Optional seed files to anchor context.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the context bundle. Defaults to 2000.

function.name: code_index_status
function.description: Check semantic index availability, staleness state (fresh, stale, missing), file count, and symbol count.

function.name: code_index_start
function.description: Start background generation or refresh of the semantic code index as a cancellable session.

incremental.description: Whether to perform an incremental update rather than full rebuild.

function.name: code_index_get
function.description: Check status and outcome of an index generation session started with code_index_start.

function.name: code_diagnostics
function.description: Query live LSP compiler diagnostics (syntax and type errors) without running a full build. Returns exact line numbers and error messages.

paths.description: File paths to check for diagnostics.

function.name: code_callers
function.description: Query compiler-accurate incoming calls / call hierarchy for a function or method from the live language server.

function.name: code_definition
function.description: Jump to definition of a symbol at a given source location using the live language server.

path.description: File path where symbol is referenced.

function.name: code_organize_imports
function.description: Compute clean import organization edits for a file via the language server.

path.description: File path to organize imports for.

function.name: code_rename
function.description: Perform a safe, compiler-backed symbol rename across all references in the workspace. Defaults to dry_run: true for preview.

path.description: File path containing the symbol to rename.

dry_run.description: If true, only previews the planned WorkspaceEdit without changing files. Defaults to true.

apply.description: Explicit confirmation to apply changes to disk. Requires approval.

function.name: code_simulate_mutation
function.description: Simulates a virtual refactoring action (e.g. deleting or renaming a symbol) in memory and identifies broken callers before modifying disk files.

new_name.description: New symbol name for rename action.

function.name: code_architecture_violations
function.description: Analyzes project dependencies to discover circular dependencies and layered architecture violations.

function.name: code_git_hotspots
function.description: Identifies codebase hotspots and high-risk files based on commit frequency, churn rate, and complexity.

limit.description: Maximum number of hotspots to return.
